 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. It's Week 8 of the 2026 NFL season and there are four teams on bye — the 49ers, Texans, Saints and Giants. Houston's defense was viewed as elite going into this season, but has been inconsistent as a unit so far, at least for fantasy football. Still, the Texans D/ST is rostered in most Yahoo leagues, leaving plenty of managers looking for a streaming option off the waiver wire.
 Below, Yahoo analysts Justin Boone, Matt Harmon, Scott Pianowski, Joel Smyth and Hayden Winks provide their defense rankings for Week 8.
